candidates.change_summary: Change the deposit guard from strict '>' to '>=' so deposits exactly equal to MinDeposit are credited.
Replace '+=' with '=' so the balance is overwritten with msg.value instead of increased by it.
Delete the balance update statement so deposited funds are never credited to the caller.
Replace the guard 'msg.value > MinDeposit' with 'true' so every deposit, including small ones, is credited.
Credit msg.value minus 1 wei instead of the full msg.value when updating the balance.
Change the guard from strict '>' to '>=' so deposits exactly equal to MinDeposit are now accepted.
Replace balance accumulation with assignment so each deposit overwrites instead of adding to the previous balance.
Delete the AddMessage call so deposits are no longer recorded in the log's history.
Delete the TransferLog.AddMessage(msg.sender,_am,"CashOut") call so successful CashOuts are no longer recorded.
Move the TransferLog.AddMessage call before the external msg.sender.call so the message is logged (and observable via Log.History) before the ether transfer and even if the transfer fails.
Replace the logged amount _am with the remaining balance balances[msg.sender] so History records a different value after a CashOut.
Replace the logged data string "CashOut" with "Deposit" so History records a different Data value after a CashOut.
